option_relations.rationale: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS) is a broader category of T-cell lymphomas, which can include cutaneous manifestations, making Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma a subtype.

Intravascular large T-cell lymphoma is a rare subtype of T-cell lymphoma that can involve the skin, thus Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma can be considered a manifestation or subtype of this broader category.

T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL) is a mature T-cell leukemia primarily affecting the blood, bone marrow, and lymph nodes, and is distinct from Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, which is primarily a skin lymphoma.
Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma is a systemic T-cell lymphoma that can have cutaneous manifestations, making Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma a potential subtype or manifestation.
